map_validate replaces ValidatedSignalMapping(**b) with SimpleNamespace(**{**b, 'transform_expression': b.get('transform_expression') or 'value'}). This drops the model's field defaults (source_property='value', disposition=MAPPED, evidence=''), its confidence Field(ge=0, le=1) bound, its compose_slots validator, and its mapping_type default of 'direct'. validate_mapping reads attributes directly so it works, but the typed contract the model provided is now unenforced and unrecorded.
The map run option table still lists --no-activate as a live flag after its removal from the CLI. Stale documentation, outside the node's write scope; flagged for a docs sweep rather than fixed here.

justifications.durability: 15: both promotions are guarded by WHERE status=<expected> and a post-update row check, so a concurrent status change cannot silently promote; map_validate refuses on any failed check instead of swallowing. Weaker: the SimpleNamespace path drops the confidence range and required-field guarantees the model enforced, so a malformed binding can now reach validate_mapping.
justifications.evidence: 15: the focused gate is green and independently reproduced (6 passed EXIT=0 at head), and I independently reproduced the refusal control (guard weakened to admit generated -> test_activate_refuses_generated_mapping FAILED EXIT=1). Weaker than full: the node recorded no paired suite arms, and its gate never executed the module that calls the removed parameter, so the regression it introduced was invisible to its own evidence.
justifications.fit: 16: mechanism-based naming, idiomatic click, no plan/ticket identifiers in code, and a matched style with the surrounding subcommands. Weaker: map_validate swapped a validated pydantic model for SimpleNamespace without comment, which sits against the repo's pydantic-for-schemas convention.
justifications.goal_fidelity: 19: every §2 clause holds and each is backed by a named passing test I reproduced at head (map run leaves generated; activate refuses generated and promotes validated; the sequence stage leaves generated), and --no-activate is gone from the CLI surface. One point withheld because the removal of the parameter left a live caller (tests/core/test_settings.py) broken, so the goal landed but the change is not self-consistent.
justifications.reuse: 15: validate_mapping and the graph client are reused, not re-derived. Weaker: the SimpleNamespace substitution abandons ValidatedSignalMapping (field defaults, confidence bounds, compose_slots validator, mapping_type default) that the code already had, duplicating its shape in a looser form rather than fixing the model construction.
justifications.scope_discipline: 15: the node stayed strictly inside its four declared write paths. Weaker: the added failure lives in tests/core/test_settings.py, which the node was fenced out of, and it neither reported that gap nor widened its gate to any file importing the functions it re-signatured, so a cross-file consequence of its own edit went unrecorded.
